destination_mask_evidence.interpretation: Zero extra descriptors is exact on the frozen extent because the observed masks are only ff, 20 and df; it is not an architectural invariant for arbitrary masks.

weight_vector_counterevidence.conclusion: Destination grouping can share the source activation/key but cannot broadcast one destination weight vector to four distinct Conv destination blocks.

P0.title: Zero bank conflict does not repair M150's invalid single-vector multicast payload
P0.evidence: All 774,144 frozen cross-destination 96-lane INT8 vector pairs differ. Four simultaneous destinations therefore require four distinct 768-bit vectors or a 6144-bit full source row with extraction; M151's one-vector broadcast does not represent the frozen Conv payload.
P0.impact: 75,032,786 cycles and 1.805357581x remain arithmetic opportunity only, not hardware-admitted speedup.
P0.disposition: Existing identity-bound cross-M150/M151/M152 correction overlay correctly sets both M152 candidate cycles and the ratio to hardware_admitted=false.

P1.title: Raw M152 contract is unsafe without overlay precedence
P1.evidence: The raw contract retains heldout_cycle_model_admitted=true and the result retains source_vector_read_once/reused=true, while the exact-bound correction overlay rejects hardware admission.
P1.impact: A consumer that reads only the raw M152 contract can resurrect the rejected 1.805x claim.
P1.disposition: Require overlay-aware consumption; no second overlay is needed. Consolidate the corrected semantics in the next contract revision.

P1.title: Four-bank accumulator read-modify-write path remains unimplemented
P1.evidence: The production result itself marks four_bank_accumulator_update_rtl=false, accumulator_sram_macro=false and same_address_forwarding=false.
P1.impact: Conflict-free destination IDs do not prove four writes per cycle, macro bandwidth, forwarding correctness, timing, area or energy.
P1.disposition: Implement four destination-bank RMW lanes and bind SRAM/macro evidence before hardware admission.

P1.title: Source-key switch and vector load-to-use cost is still absent
P1.evidence: The inherited independent M150 sensitivity rises from 75,032,786 to 96,762,797 cycles when charging only one cycle per active key, reducing the ratio versus M143r2 B4 from 1.805357581x to about 1.39993x.
P1.impact: The optimistic recurrence is highly sensitive to a missing resident-vector supply latency.
P1.disposition: Add a concrete resident store and exact key-switch/load schedule before quoting the candidate cycles.

P1.title: Zero conflict is heldout-distribution-specific
P1.evidence: Only ff, 20 and df occur among 23,522,595 active keys, while exhaustive enumeration finds 82 of 256 destination masks would require an extra modulo-four issue round relative to ideal K4.
P1.impact: The observed zero cannot be generalized to other checkpoints, Local5, layers or changed quantization gates.
P1.disposition: Keep the statement frozen-extent-only and rerun the mask ledger for every paper workload.

P1.title: Ordered signed numerical replay is missing
P1.evidence: The full recompute contains 17,557,357 negative source events, 9.331649% of 188,148,490 events, while ordered_signed_numeric_trace_replay=false.
P1.impact: Destination and sign metadata conservation has not been demonstrated through the proposed supply and accumulator paths.
P1.disposition: Replay ordered signed INT8-to-Acc19 updates after vector supply and writeback are materialized.

P2.title: Source-vector terminology conflates activation reuse with weight-vector reuse
P2.evidence: The bank grouping legitimately reuses a source activation/key, but each destination owns a different 96-lane weight vector.
P2.disposition: Rename the reusable object to source activation/key and state the destination-vector multiplicity explicitly.

P2.title: Contract omits destination-mask concentration
P2.evidence: 99.975377% of active keys use mask ff; this concentration explains the zero-conflict result but is absent from the paper-safe statement.
P2.disposition: Publish the three-mask histogram beside the zero-conflict total to make representativeness auditable.
